//: Simulates a downstream consumer compiling against the package the way the README prescribes: automatic JSX runtime via jsxImportSource, strict mode, moduleResolution bundler, and crucially NO @types/bun (types: []). Because the package ships raw .ts, tsc type-checks railroad's own source through these imports — so this catches regressions like a bare `globalThis.Bun` (TS7017) or a list() keyFn that fails to infer. `paths` maps the package name to the repo root.
